query: SELECT pf.id FROM job_item ji JOIN mapping m ON m.org_id = ji.org_id AND m.id = ji.mapping_id JOIN product_file pf ON pf.org_id = m.org_id AND pf.product_id = m.product_id WHERE ji.org_id = $1 AND ji.lease_owner = $2 AND ji.state IN ('leased', 'running', 'verifying') AND pf.role IN ('payload', 'cover') AND pf.deleted_at IS NULL
